I couldn't download the template, so nothing has been saved to /documents.

The download page on www.resume-templates.com has one link, "Resume Template (PDF)". It points to a different domain: `https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf`. I tried that link twice, once as a download and once in the browser. Both times it returned "Source Not Found" / 404.

Alice may have meant a different link or file. I'd ask her to confirm the correct URL, or to send the template as an attachment. If she sends a new link, I'll download it to /documents right away.
